payload.previous_proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the standard definition of the fractional part function, frac(x) is exactly the difference between x and its integer part floor(x). Hence frac(x) = x - floor(x), as claimed.
payload.role_in_assembly: Identifies the fractional part with the floor-remainder expression so that the inequality and equality lemmas can be rewritten into statements about frac(x).
